color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist. Palette: #161d25 midnight, #21f3b6 aurora teal, #9248e4 violet, #e2ff65 lime.

type-system.twistDescription: Replaced heading stack with Syne 700/800 (geometric futuristic). Body remains Inter 400/500. h1 clamp 64–120px. Added --color-aurora-glow CSS var for headline text-shadow.

motion-system.twistDescription: 8 aurora keyframes: auroraShimmer, glowPulse, auroraBand, cosmicReveal, gradientDrift, auroraGlow, particleDrift, borderGlow. Primary easing liquid cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). aurora-drift 8s, aurora-cycle 20s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Widened container to 1480px max-width, 32px padding-inline, 28px gap at 1440px. 12-column grid preserved.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Section vertical padding expanded to 120px for aurora breathing room. Card padding expanded to 32px.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Aurora Glow Physics: hover = scale(1.02) + teal glow. Cards = translateY(-4px) + violet glow. Links = lime text-shadow. Focus = teal outline. No color changes — luminosity only.

nav-system.twistDescription: Dark transparent nav gains aurora teal hairline border-bottom on scroll. 68px height. Logo white. Links lime on hover.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Aurora/Gradient Glow analysis: luminous gradient mesh, spectral palette progression, glow diffusion physics. Video placements: aurora-timelapse.mp4 (hero 15s), gradient-refraction.mp4 (features 8s), dark-water-surface.mp4 (about 10s).
